title: Exact Rational Linear Programming Duality & Non-Erasure Certificate Verification

claim_hygiene.what_it_supports: Shows that on the uniform 3-cycle cochain complex over Q, exact rational weak duality certifies that the quotient defect mass is Phi_1([c]) = 1, certifying non-erasure of the obstruction without floating-point approximations.
claim_hygiene.what_it_does_not_support: Does not establish strong duality for infinite complexes, continuous function spaces, or unverified approximate search heuristics.
claim_hygiene.narrowest_defensible_claim: The certificate pair (alpha*, w*) satisfies exact primal and dual feasibility with vanishing rational duality gap in Q, certifying Phi_1([c]) = 1 for c = (1/3, 1/3, 1/3).
claim_hygiene.next_test_needed: Integrate with the Rust omega_functional exact rational simplex certifier across higher-degree complexes.
